rules.instruction: When the description states that one stage begins right after a completed sequence of steps, and it names no new event, message, time or condition that starts that stage: Do not model a start event for that stage. Connect the last element of the preceding sequence to the first element of the stage with a sequence flow in the same process, so that the stage stays on the main flow. Use a parallel split gateway only if the description states that two or more following activities run simultaneously.
rules.situation: the description states that one stage begins right after a completed sequence of steps, and it names no new event, message, time or condition that starts that stage

rules.instruction: When the description says that a participant has to wait until an external party confirms something it has already provided, and that wait happens on one branch of a parallel split whose other branches continue meanwhile: Model the wait for the external confirmation as an intermediate catch event on that branch, placed after the task in which the participant provides the information. Do not add a separate send task for the handover unless the description names sending as its own action. Join the branch with the other parallel branches at a parallel gateway, with a sequence flow from the wait event into that join gateway.
rules.situation: the description says that a participant has to wait until an external party confirms something it has already provided, and that wait happens on one branch of a parallel split whose other branches continue meanwhile

rules.instruction: When the description states that two or more activities run at the same time (joined by 'while' or 'and', or stated as simultaneous), and a later step starts only after all of them are finished: Model the concurrent activities as separate branches that start at one parallel gateway, with each activity in its own branch and placed in the lane of the participant who performs it. Close all branches with one matching parallel gateway placed before the later step. Do not sequence the concurrent activities one after another, do not omit an activity or merge it into another, and do not use an exclusive gateway, because it would choose one path while the description requires all of them to proceed.
rules.situation: the description says that after a step, one branch contains a wait for an external confirmation (for example a bank or other party confirming something) while another activity in parallel with it is still running, and a later step starts only after both are finished

rules.instruction: When the description lists several activities that all follow the same preceding event and are performed together, and a later step continues only after all of them are done: Model an opening parallel gateway after the preceding step, with one branch per listed activity, and close those branches with a joining parallel gateway before the next step. Do not chain the activities in sequence, and do not use an exclusive gateway to join them.
rules.situation: the description states that, after a step, several activities are performed simultaneously and the process continues only after all of them are finished
